utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with that—what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. The fence gate is the first thing that’s really giving me trouble.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—I'll start with the fence gate. I'll check the hinges and latch first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the exact time, where it’s happening, and what we’re expected to bring. I just don’t want us to get caught short on the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, fair — can you confirm the exact time, location, and what we need to bring?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can, but I need the details first—once you’ve got the time, place, and a list of what to bring, I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit behind on the details, but I’m happy to help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Noah — that’d be a huge help. I’m just trying to gather what still needs fixing, so if you know anything, let me know and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can check around and see if I missed anything. If I notice a broken fence, loose step, or anything else, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m happy to help with the repair drive — I’ll check what still needs doing and let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate it. Let me know what still needs doing and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll check what’s left and share the plan with everyone soon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries at all — it’s going pretty well so far, just a few more fixes to knock out. If you need a hand or a tool, I’ve got you covered.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — that’s great to hear. I’m here now, so point me to the next fix and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let’s keep it simple and stick to a clear plan for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep it clear. I’ll invite folks to the repair drive and make sure everyone knows the plan.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn — that helps a lot. Just keep me posted if anything changes, and we’ll stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Mina — I’m still in for the repair drive today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I meet you?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We still need to check which houses are left on the list and note any addresses that already got covered.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it—I’ll go through the list and mark any covered addresses so we know what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m in for the repair drive—tell me what still needs doing and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Mara — thank you. We still need a few volunteers to sort supplies, make reminder calls, and help on the day of the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take the reminder calls and help on the day of the drive. Just tell me when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of what we still need for the repair drive—just tell me what’s been gathered so far.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — I haven’t got the list handy, but I can check and send you what’s been gathered so far.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — send it over when you can, and I’ll keep the running list updated.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a lot of donations already. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. Thanks, Tess — I’d appreciate any updates.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and tell you if I hear any new details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the exact time and where we’re meeting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — we’re meeting at 9:00 a.m. by the community center entrance.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — 9:00 a.m. at the community center entrance. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the basics for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll send you the basics for the repair drive as soon as I’m back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just text me the essentials when you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to a few neighbors and see who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that would be a huge help. Let me know who’s interested, and I’ll line up the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll ask around today and let you know who’s interested.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a little distracted today, but I’m in if you need help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I could really use the help when you’ve got a moment.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing, Uli — just give me a nudge when you need me, and I’ll come by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll swing by and see what needs fixing. Just point me to the repair drive and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Rey — it’s down by the community shed. I’ll point you to the tables when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’m on my way now and I’ll look for the tables by the shed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve got the repair drive organized and we’re ready to get started. If you want, I can walk you through what still needs volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please — can you tell me what still needs volunteers and where to go first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Start at the community center, where we still need a few people to sort donations and greet folks. After that, the repair table by the front entrance could use an extra hand, too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the schedule and where things should go first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the schedule and the drop-off spots right away, and I’ll make sure you have the full repair-drive details before you come by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that would help a lot. Once I have the details, I can see what I can manage.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we actually have the repair drive confirmed, or is it still tentative?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have it confirmed yet, so I’d treat it as tentative until we double-check.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll treat it as tentative for now. Let me know once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep this simple—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still catching up, but I can help with the repair drive—what part do you want me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Could you handle the sign-up list and timing, and let me know by this evening? I’ll be ready once I have that.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest yet—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s coming along well so far — we’ve gathered a good bit of supplies, but we could still use a few more donated tools and screws.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s good to hear. I’ll pass it along and keep an ear out for any extra tools or screws.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, Mara; just remind me what I promised to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — you said you’d bring your drill and a few extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, that’s right — my drill and a few extension cords. I’ll bring them over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need the actual repair drive details first—what time and where is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s at my place on Maple, Saturday at 2 pm. I’ll send the full details now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks—Maple on Saturday at 2 works for me. Send the full details and I’ll plan around it.
